title: How can Ziva fix a total with a forgotten number?
description: A long list of numbers was added and one number was forgotten. The forgotten number is added to the old total instead of starting again. Keeko doubts this and wants to add all the numbers again from the start.
teaching_notes: One idea: the order of adding does not matter, so a forgotten term can be added last to the total already found. Watch for children who think the whole sum must be done again.

source: Ziva is adding a long list of numbers: 1342, 774, 8611, 9055 and 1022. It took five minutes to add them all and the answer was 11749. Then Ziva realised that the fourth number 9055 had been forgotten. Does Ziva have to start all over again?
video_script.why: The child sees that a forgotten term can be added to the old total, because the order of adding does not matter.
video_script.substitution: Keep the total of the numbers already added, and add the forgotten number to it in two easy parts.
video_script.anchor: A long list of numbers with one forgotten number, nine thousand fifty five
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks the forgotten number can only be handled by adding all five numbers again from the start.
video_script.payoff_line: The correct total is twenty thousand eight hundred four

final_answer.spoken: the correct total is twenty thousand eight hundred four

names.Ziva: the child who added a long list of numbers and forgot one

never_show: adding all five numbers again marked as necessary
maths_rules: the order of adding does not matter, so 9055 can be added last
video_script.design: One idea: the order of adding does not matter, so the forgotten term goes last. Assumes adding large numbers by breaking one into parts. Wrong idea: the whole sum must be started again. The old total stays on the board all video.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; Ziva with a long column of numbers 1342, 774, 8611, 9055, 1022 and the total 11749, with 9055 marked as forgotten

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='list'/>Ziva added a long list of numbers but forgot to include one of them.
<bookmark mark='total'/>The total came to eleven thousand seven hundred forty nine. The forgotten number is nine thousand fifty five.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How can Ziva get the correct total?

beats.on_screen: the numbers and the old total stay on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='split'/>A big number can be broken into parts to make adding smoother. Nine thousand fifty five is nine thousand and fifty five.

beats.on_screen: Given: the other four numbers gave 11749; forgotten number 9055

marks.given: the old total and the forgotten number are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the four numbers added so far came to eleven thousand seven hundred forty nine. The forgotten number is nine thousand fifty five.

beats.on_screen: To find: the correct total of all five numbers

marks.find: the words correct total are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the correct total of all five numbers without starting again.

marks.keep: the old total 11749 is boxed and kept

narration: <bookmark mark='keep'/>Step one, keep the old total. The work already done is eleven thousand seven hundred forty nine, and it stays.

beats.on_screen: the order of adding does not matter, so 11749 + 9055

marks.order: the forgotten number moves to the end of the sum

narration: <bookmark mark='order'/>Step two, remember that the order of adding does not matter. The forgotten number can be added last.
<bookmark mark='write'/>The correct total is eleven thousand seven hundred forty nine plus nine thousand fifty five.

marks.thou: 9000 is added to 11749 and the result 20749 appears

narration: <bookmark mark='thou'/>Step three, add the nine thousand first. Eleven thousand seven hundred forty nine plus nine thousand is twenty thousand seven hundred forty nine.
<bookmark mark='rest'/>Step four, add the last fifty five to twenty thousand seven hundred forty nine.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The correct total is twenty thousand eight hundred four. Ziva does not need to start again.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows: add all five numbers again from the start; beside it the old total 11749 kept; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.fix: the old total glows and the bubble is struck through
marks.last: the forgotten number is placed beside the old total

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks Ziva must add all five numbers again from the start.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But the old total already holds four of the numbers. <bookmark mark='last'/>The order of adding does not matter, and the forgotten number only needs to be added to it.
